movers.headline: takes **four MoRTH letters of acceptance aggregating Rs 2,149.62 crore** for NH-913 Frontier Highway packages in Arunachal Pradesh, through a **joint venture in which it holds 74%**
movers.quantum: Rs 2,149.62 cr JV bid cost; ~39.1% of mcap

movers.headline: receives a **Rs 193.92 crore letter of intent from APTRANSCO**, including GST, to design, manufacture, test and supply **12 units of 160 MVA, 220/132 kV auto transformers**
movers.quantum: Rs 193.92 cr incl GST; ~1.4% of mcap

movers.headline: wins a **Rs 166.80 crore work order from the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation**, a one-year extension of its Infrastructure-as-a-Service engagement with additional components, to run to 9 February 2027
movers.quantum: Rs 166.80 cr incl tax; ~1.9% of mcap

movers.headline: takes a **three-year, approximately Rs 134 crore work order from Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation** for integrated facility management in the Mumbai and Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar regions
movers.quantum: Rs 134.00 cr incl taxes; ~15.5% of mcap

movers.headline: secures an **approximately Rs 128 crore pre-engineered steel building order** for an international FMCG maker's homecare and beauty plant, over about 10 months, the customer withheld for confidentiality
movers.quantum: Rs 128.00 cr incl taxes; ~4.4% of mcap

movers.headline: wins a **Rs 116 crore turnkey EPC contract from KPI Green Energy** for a 200 MW solar project at Bikaner, through material subsidiary Advait Greenergy, over 12 months
movers.quantum: Rs 116.00 cr excl taxes; ~5.1% of mcap

movers.headline: buys a **29.43% stake in Ignitium Services for Rs 16.04 crore** cash by subscribing to its equity, taking a holding in a fuel-delivery and energy-services business, to complete within seven working days

business_updates: **Results season** — **97 companies filed results or earnings-call material** today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Prism Johnson** — declared successful bidder for **1,28,000 tonnes a year of coal linkage** from Eastern and South Eastern Coalfields on 10-year fuel supply agreements, taking total linkage to **2,79,400 TPA**, about half the cement division's annual fuel need. This is coal the company BUYS, at a stated **Rs 70.49 crore a year**, not an order won.
**Hindustan Zinc** — raises **renewable power consumption to 22%** and targets 70% by FY28.
**Mamata Machinery** — files an **Indian patent application for the die and screw design** behind RecTech, its recyclable film technology.
**Blue Cloud Softech Solutions** — **admitted to trading on the National Stock Exchange**.
**Admach Systems** — press release on the **total order book** of the company.
capex_core: **Tara Chand InfraLogistic Solutions** — completes the purchase of an **800 MT crawler crane, a 700 MT all-terrain crane and two 58-metre aerial platforms**, to be deployed against renewable-energy and petrochemical orders. The **Rs 74.20 crore** it cites is FY27 capex **to date**, not the price of these four machines, which the filing does not state.
**Exide Industries** — a **further investment in Exide Energy Solutions**, its wholly owned lithium-cell subsidiary.
**Syrma SGS Technology** — incorporates a **subsidiary jointly with Kaga Electronics India**.
**HLE Glascoat** — update on its investment in **HLE International S.à r.l.**, a wholly owned subsidiary in Luxembourg.
**Bulkcorp International** — sets up **Production Unit 2** for specialised, value-added FIBC products.
**GG Automotive Gears** — update on the **restoration of production capacity** after a fire.
distress_risk: **Sadhav Shipping** — reports the **termination of its contract agreement with the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority**.
**G R Infraprojects** — update on litigation at **Nagaur Mukundgarh Highways**, a subsidiary.
**Samvardhana Motherson International** — status update on the **scheme undertaken by subsidiary Motherson Technology Services**.
**Dharan Infra-EPC** — discloses an **ongoing SEBI investigation** and its submission of information.
**JSW Dulux** — update on **pending litigation** under Regulation 30.
**Future Consumer** — **postpones** the second meeting of its committee of creditors.
**Videocon Industries** and **Value Industries** — pre-facto intimation of the 64th meeting of their committee of creditors, on 21 August.
equity_allotments: **Innomet Advanced Materials** — board approves an **allotment of securities worth Rs 5.89 crore**.
**Audroc** — allots **7,50,00,000 fully convertible equity warrants** to two allottees.
**Eiko Lifesciences** — converts **3,05,000 warrants into equity shares** held by promoter and non-promoter holders — a past-warrant conversion, not new capital.
**JMJ Fintech** — a **Rs 1.58 crore preferential issue**, disclosed under Regulation 30.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Kshitij Polyline** — issues the **letter of offer for its Rs 29.34 crore rights issue**: 9,25,46,925 shares at **Rs 3.17** including a Rs 1.17 premium, **two for every five held**, record date 19 August. The 17-Aug digest carried the same issue at the rights-entitlement ISIN stage _(~46.7% of mcap)_.

**Atal Realtech** — files the **draft letter of offer for the rights issue of not more than Rs 16 crore** it intimated on 12 August, with the price, entitlement ratio and record date still to be set _(~3.6% of mcap)_.
**Rajgor Castor Derivatives** — outcome of its rights-issue committee meeting held on 18 August.
m_and_a: **HEG** — the NCLT Indore bench **sanctions the composite scheme of arrangement** the company had filed.
**Jubilant Ingrevia** — board approves entry into a **binding term sheet with Zettaone Technologies**.
**Happiest Minds Technologies** — receives the certified true copy of the NCLT Bengaluru final order on the **amalgamation of Aureustech Systems**.
**One Mobikwik Systems** — update on its **slump sale**.
**BLS International Services** — **merger of a step-down subsidiary** of the company.
**RHI Magnesita India** — the merger of **Intermetal Engineers (India) into Ashwath Technologies** becomes effective.
**Markolines Pavement Technologies** — receives **observation letters with no adverse objection** from BSE and NSE.
**Crest Ventures** — incorporates **step-down wholly owned subsidiary companies**.
order_wins: **Ganesh Infraworld** — subsidiary Tykoon Mines GK is the **lowest bidder (L1) on an approximately Rs 453.16 crore, five-year contract** for Central Coalfields' SDOC mine in the Dhori area of Bokaro. The company states that L1 status **is not an award** _(~94.9% of mcap)_.

**EMS Limited** — takes **highest-bidder (H-1) status on two NHAI user-fee plazas**, Rangamati on NH-37 and Bartana on NH-352A, together about **Rs 42.22 crore** for one year; the company awaits the letter of award _(~2.1% of mcap)_.

**Compucom Software** — a **Rs 4.77 crore work order from Rajasthan Skill and Livelihoods Development Corporation** to train 350 and place 245 rural youth under DDU-GKY 2.0, over about 36 months _(~4.5% of mcap)_.
**Monarch Surveyors** — a **Rs 4.39 crore work order** to provide 50 licensed surveyors to the district land-records office in Amravati, Maharashtra _(~1.4% of mcap)_.
**H.G. Infra Engineering** — receipt of a **letter of intent from REC Power Development and Consultancy**, in continuation of its announcement of 26 May 2026, with no value in the row.
**Anlon Technology Solutions** — reports the bagging of an order under Regulation 30, with no counterparty and no value in the row.
**Valplast Technologies** — reports the receipt of a new order under Regulation 30, with no counterparty and no value in the row.
other_notable: **ONGC** — the Exchange has **sought clarification** on a news item reporting that ONGC has a US licence to resume full Venezuela operations and is eyeing operatorship.
**Aegis Logistics** — the Exchange has **sought clarification** on an Economic Times report that it is in talks to acquire the UAE's Tristar for $1.5 billion.
**Reliance Industries** — the Exchange has **sought clarification** on a news item reporting a Rs 10 lakh Supreme Court fine over delay in the NTPC gas-supply suit.
**Advanced Enzyme Technologies** — **buyback of equity shares from the open market** through the stock-exchange mechanism.
